---
title: "Bharay Darbar Mein Bulaya Gaya"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Saqlain"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Bharay Darbar Mein Bulaya Gaya.
Haye Zahra Ko Youn Sataya Gaya.
Baap Ke Naam Par Hakomat Thi.
Our Beti Ka Ghar Jalaya Gaya.

2
Kya Madine Ke Loag Andhay Thay?.
Hath Zahra Pe Jab Uthaya Gaya.
Murtaza Cheekh Cheekh Kar Roye.
Hath Pehlu Se Jab Hataya Gaya.

3
Loag Chalte Rahe Jalay Dar Par.
Dar Ko Zahra Se Na Uthaya Gaya.
Raat Ki Jal Chuki Thi Woh Chokhat.
Koi Roney Magar Na Aaya Gaya.

4
Parha Jis Dar Pe Mustafa Ne Darood.
Thokaron Se Ossay Giraya Gaya.
Kaisay Saqlain Pasliyaan Totein.
Sirf Zainab Ko Yeh Bataya Gaya.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/bharay-darbar-mein-bulaya-gaya-tajpoints-14926c30657a50d1e1a0.md\")
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split(\"---\", 2)
roman = yaml.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)[1]
for edition, digits in [(roman, \"1234\"), (body, \"۱۲۳۴\")]:
    blocks = [b.splitlines() for b in edition.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")]
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, digit in zip(blocks, digits):
        assert len(block) == 5 and block[0].strip() == digit
print(\"Both editions contain four numbered stanzas of four verses.\")
PY"
